name: Ozon
verdict: Brand of MKPAO Ozon, an e-commerce company listed on the Moscow Exchange; its largest shareholders are AO O23 (34.95%, held by structures of businessman Alexander Chachava) and AFK Sistema (31.80%), with the remaining 33.25% spread among minorities. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: 2025 annual report (structure as of 1 March 2026) names AO O23 (34.95%) and AFK Sistema (31.80%, incl. Sistema Venture Fund) as the big shareholders of Moscow Exchange–listed MKPAO Ozon; no state stake or board control found, and no human-rights finding against the company found. Krasnodar partner since April 2025 (kit logo + Ozon Arena stadium naming) with the deal running to 2029.
